notablePrerequisites: Any Cleric creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Orah, adding {C}{C}.
When Orah dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve Orah's trigger, returning any Cleric card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
With Nim Deathmantle's trigger still on the stack, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the returned Cleric, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, paying {4} to return Orah from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to them.
Repeat.
